# Magu: The art of inspiring flavours

By Ndéla Faye | Photos: Robert Lindström 

Magu is a plant-based restaurant, with seasonal menus crafted as self-contained culinary narratives.

R estaurants Magu and LOBO, in central Helsinki, exemplify chef Felipe Moya’s vision and skill in creating dishes and spaces that are intentional, inspiring and inviting.

Chilean-born chef Felipe Moya’s work is guided by precision and deep respect for ingredients, from sourcing to the careful minimisation of waste. At Magu and LOBO, diners are invited to trust the process and experience a chef working at the height of his craft. That mastery has not gone unnoticed: Moya was recently shortlisted among the top three for Head Chef of the Year 2025.

Ecological values are at the core of Moya’s ethos. At Magu, this is evident in the food as well as in recycled glassware, restored furnishings and a kitchen that minimises waste, reuses equipment and favours slow, traditional preparation methods.

This year, the plant-based restaurant celebrates its eighth anniversary – and shows no signs of slowing down. “Our mission is simple: to use what grows in nature, to experiment, to expand the palate and to inspire,” Moya says.

Despite its fine-dining format, the 9- and 14-course menus are approachable and accessible, appealing both to vegans and to diners simply curious about what can be created using plants. The result is fine dining that feels refined yet grounded, guided by seasonal menus conceived as self-contained narratives. Vegetables, berries and mushrooms are preserved during warmer months, allowing the kitchen to remain creative throughout the winter.

...

Heritage on the plate

Located in Helsinki’s Katajanokka district, LOBO offers a five-course menu as well as add-ons, which can create an eight-course menu experience – with a seasonal, convivial bistro-style approach. For Moya, it is the clearest expression of his dual heritage, where Nordic ingredients – mushrooms, lake fish, roots and herbs – meet Latin influences and Chilean home cooking. “You’ll eat things you recognise, but in a way you’ve never had them before. The dishes are windows into my memories,” he says.

highlights:
Vegan Restaurants in Helsinki: Best Places to Eat

# Best vegan joints in Helsinki

The range of vegan food in Helsinki’s eateries is impressive and expanding all the time. Numerous completely vegan restaurants and cafés can be found throughout the city, making it easy and convenient for those who want to enjoy vegan food without having to ask and check first.

 

Created 

16 Nov 2024

## Healthy versus junky – Helsinki has it all

Just a decade or so ago, Finnish fans of vegan food travelled abroad in search of the restaurant experiences they were longing for: to places like Berlin, Stockholm and Tallinn. When the “vegan boom” finally started here around 2015, the selection increased dramatically. The first hub of vegan food in Helsinki was on Vaasankatu in the Kallio district, but nowadays excellent vegan meals can be found throughout the city.

This article focuses on restaurants and cafés that serve only vegan food. In addition to great lunch places, these places serve excellent fast food, fine dining and café products, including a diversity from “Americana” to traditional Finnish delicacies. In addition to these vegan establishments, Helsinki also has many vegetarian restaurants that serve a varied range of vegan dishes (such as Banu Café, Zucchini and Yes Yes Yes). On top of these, the city offers excellent vegan food across a wide range of international cuisine.

### Brindavan & Bhajan Café

 Brindavan & Bhajan Café in Vallila neighbourhood serves a generous buffet that invites you to savour an Indian-inspired lunch. Choose from a light and fresh selection of salads and spreads, or you can enjoy a hearty lunch with baked potatoes and stews – and everything in between! The price is determined by weight. The flavours vary from mild to fiery, so there is something for everyone in the wide selection. 

### Rakastan Café

 Rakastan is an absolute must for visitors in particular, as this café in the heart of the city serves vegan versions of a traditional Finnish delicacy, Karelian pies, filled with potatoes or barley. On top of the pies, you can choose “egg butter”, a favourite among Finns, fish roe and onion in the Swedish style, or pickles with syrup in the Slavic style. The café also serves soup lunches and pastries, and on weekend evenings you can enjoy Finnish tapas with wine. The milieu is beautiful and exudes history. 

### Magu

 Favouring seasonal ingredients and local food, Magu is a laid-back fine dining restaurant that invites everyone to try its exquisite cuisine. There is an extensive tasting menu and a smaller set menu, as well as a wine menu paired with both. The vegan dishes combine influences from around the world.

### Thai Vegan Kitchen and Peace Kitchen

 Thai Vegan Kitchen on Lapinlahdenkatu in Central Helsinki, known originally for its legendary street food, has successfully maintained this spirit in its restaurant and positively exudes a desire to promote the cause of vegan food. In addition to the daily specials, you can enjoy a wide and varied selection of traditional Thai delicacies, as well as samples from other East Asian cuisines. Here you can familiarise yourself with a versatile selection of vegetable proteins, and the flavouring of the dishes is really skilful. Its sister restaurant Peace Kitchen in Kallio specialises in noodles! 

### Other vegan restaurants and cafés

 In addition to all the above, Helsinki has many others great vegan restaurants and cafés. The selection keeps changing, of course, as newcomers are arriving all the time, while some old favourites that have been temporarily closed are eagerly expected to reopen soon. 

One of the newest vegan hotpots is Restaurant Lohtu on the second floor of recently renovated Hakaniemi Market Hall. Encanto is an art café that serves vegan breakfasts, salads and toasts. Plants by us inside the Forum shopping centre specialises in vegan sandwiches. Loving Hut, known from its popular food carts at festivals, serves East Asian vegan lunches. Sen Chay is a lunch restaurant serving East Asian vegan cuisine where you can also enjoy an early dinner. Roots Helsinki is the combination of vegan food, yoga and well-being. You can also hop on the metro to Espoo, where you will find the classic vegetarian restaurant Anne’s Vege and the Kipsari student restaurant, café and bar.

Helsingin parhaat kasvis- ja vegaaniravintolat 2026

# Helsingin parhaat kasvis- ja vegaaniravintolat 2026

 Julkaistu 17.5.2026 · Ruokapaikat-toimitus 

Kuvituskuva. Havainnollistava kuva, ei ravintoloiden virallinen materiaali.

Helsingin parhaat kasvisravintolat ovat tässä listassa Yes Yes Yes Punavuoressa ja Grön Kampissa. Helsingin kasvisravintolatarjonta on kasvanut siihen pisteeseen, että kasvisruokaa ei tarvitse enää etsiä sekalistan reunalta. Osassa ravintoloita koko keittiö on rakennettu kasvisten ympärille alusta asti.

Tähän listaan on koottu paikat, joissa kasvisruoka on lähtökohta eikä lisävaihtoehto. Tiedot on tarkistettu ravintoloiden omilta sivuilta elokuussa 2026.

## Yes Yes Yes: kasvisravintola Punavuoressa

Yes Yes Yes Iso Roobertinkadulla on täysin kasvisravintola. Talon oma muotoilu on osuva: ruoka sattuu olemaan kasvisruokaa, eikä sitä nosteta erikseen esiin.

Annokset rakennetaan sesonkiraaka-aineista ja lista vaihtuu niiden mukaan. Esillä on ollut esimerkiksi punajuuririsottoa, grillattua kurpitsaa, kaalisalaattia chilicrunchilla ja halloumiranskalaisia.

Ravintola on auki maanantaista perjantaihin kello 16-23, lauantaisin kello 12-23 ja sunnuntaisin kello 16-21. Lauantaisin ovet avautuvat siis jo keskipäivällä.

Yes Yes Yes järjestää myös yksityistilaisuuksia räätälöidyllä menulla, mikä tekee siitä toimivan valinnan tilaisuuteen, jossa seurueessa on eri ruokavalioita.

## Grön: kasvispainotteinen fine dining Kampissa

Grön Albertinkadulla on Michelin-tähden ja Green Star -kestävyystunnustuksen saanut ravintola. Sali on pieni, 16 paikkaa, ja keittiö on avoin.

Ravintola tarjoaa kaksi menua, joista toinen on täysin vegaaninen. Ruoka perustuu sesonkiin, luomuun ja villiraaka-aineisiin.

Vieraat saapuvat joko kello 17 tai kello 20, ja kokit tarjoilevat ja esittelevät annokset itse. Pöytävaraus kannattaa tehdä hyvissä ajoin, koska paikkoja on vähän.

Grön on tämän listan kallein vaihtoehto ja sopii juhlaillalliseen, ei arkiruokailuun.

## Kasvisvaihtoehdot muissa ravintoloissa

Kaikki hyvät kasvisannokset eivät ole kasvisravintoloissa. BasBasin bistrolinjalta ja Nollan sesonkiin nojaavasta keittiöstä löytyy kasvisruokaa, joka ei ole jälkikäteen listalle lisätty vaihtoehto.

Tintå Turussa ja Story Vanhassa kauppahallissa tarjoavat molemmat oman kasvisannoksensa päivittäin. Jos reitti vie Jyväskylään, vegaanista lounasta tarjoaa Katriina.

## Yhteenveto

Jos haet kasvisravintolaa arki-illalle, aloita Yes Yes Yesistä. Jos etsit juhlaillallista, Grön on Helsingin kunnianhimoisin kasvispainotteinen vaihtoehto.

Molemmat vaativat pöytävarauksen viikonlopuksi. Tarkista ajantasainen lista ja hinnat ravintolan omilta sivuilta ennen käyntiä, koska sesonkilistat vaihtuvat usein.

Magu, Helsinki: White Guide Fine Level | Wattafork

 

# Magu

Magu in Helsinki serves a seasonal vegan tasting menu shaped by global kitchens and Finnish produce, recognised by the White Guide 2026.

## Magu – Helsinki's Vegan Restaurant Earning White Guide Recognition

### A plant-based restaurant with a point of view

Magu sits on Korkeavuorenkatu 27 in Helsinki, open Wednesday to Saturday evenings, and it arrives with a clear conviction: that plant-based cooking deserves the same care, creativity, and technical rigour as any other fine dining. The White Guide 2026 awarded it Fine level recognition, noting the presence of chef and forager Ossi Paloneva — a figure familiar to Finnish food culture through television appearances and food festivals dedicated to wild, local produce.

### The kitchen behind the menu

Head Chef Felipe brings a different but complementary thread to the story. His path through Helsinki kitchens — including Farang, Pastor, and Pure Bistro — gave him a foundation in global flavours before Magu sharpened his focus entirely on plant-based cooking. As he puts it, the experience taught him "to make every ingredient shine, even without meat or dairy." The result is a style built on colour, layering, and texture: dishes designed to be experienced visually before the first bite.

### What's on the plate

The current dinner menu, Flora, is priced at 79€ and reads like a considered sequence of contrasts. It opens with a watercress and pea gazpacho and flower onigiri, moves through hibiscus brioche with sorrel, soba noodles with summer truffles and sesame seeds, and a cauliflower with black garlic and rendang curry — a dish that draws on Southeast Asian spicing without losing its Finnish grounding. It closes with pine tree sorbet and a strawberry, rosemary, and almond cake. The menu changes with the seasons, paired with a selection of natural wines that evolves alongside it.

### The spirit of the place

Magu's own words resist the usual language of fine dining: "to using what grows, to trying new things, to widening the palette." That ethos — practical, curious, unshowy — runs through everything from the sourcing to the plating. For anyone serious about vegan cooking in Helsinki, this is a table worth booking.

# Helsingin parhaat kasvis- ja vegaaniravintolat 2026

 Julkaistu 17.5.2026 · Ruokapaikat-toimitus 

Kuvituskuva. Havainnollistava kuva, ei ravintoloiden virallinen materiaali.

Helsingin parhaat kasvisravintolat ovat tässä listassa Yes Yes Yes Punavuoressa ja Grön Kampissa. Helsingin kasvisravintolatarjonta on kasvanut siihen pisteeseen, että kasvisruokaa ei tarvitse enää etsiä sekalistan reunalta. Osassa ravintoloita koko keittiö on rakennettu kasvisten ympärille alusta asti.

Tähän listaan on koottu paikat, joissa kasvisruoka on lähtökohta eikä lisävaihtoehto. Tiedot on tarkistettu ravintoloiden omilta sivuilta elokuussa 2026.

## Yes Yes Yes: kasvisravintola Punavuoressa

Yes Yes Yes Iso Roobertinkadulla on täysin kasvisravintola. Talon oma muotoilu on osuva: ruoka sattuu olemaan kasvisruokaa, eikä sitä nosteta erikseen esiin.

Annokset rakennetaan sesonkiraaka-aineista ja lista vaihtuu niiden mukaan. Esillä on ollut esimerkiksi punajuuririsottoa, grillattua kurpitsaa, kaalisalaattia chilicrunchilla ja halloumiranskalaisia.

Ravintola on auki maanantaista perjantaihin kello 16-23, lauantaisin kello 12-23 ja sunnuntaisin kello 16-21. Lauantaisin ovet avautuvat siis jo keskipäivällä.

Yes Yes Yes järjestää myös yksityistilaisuuksia räätälöidyllä menulla, mikä tekee siitä toimivan valinnan tilaisuuteen, jossa seurueessa on eri ruokavalioita.

## Grön: kasvispainotteinen fine dining Kampissa

Grön Albertinkadulla on Michelin-tähden ja Green Star -kestävyystunnustuksen saanut ravintola. Sali on pieni, 16 paikkaa, ja keittiö on avoin.

Ravintola tarjoaa kaksi menua, joista toinen on täysin vegaaninen. Ruoka perustuu sesonkiin, luomuun ja villiraaka-aineisiin.

Vieraat saapuvat joko kello 17 tai kello 20, ja kokit tarjoilevat ja esittelevät annokset itse. Pöytävaraus kannattaa tehdä hyvissä ajoin, koska paikkoja on vähän.

Grön on tämän listan kallein vaihtoehto ja sopii juhlaillalliseen, ei arkiruokailuun.

## Kasvisvaihtoehdot muissa ravintoloissa

Kaikki hyvät kasvisannokset eivät ole kasvisravintoloissa. BasBasin bistrolinjalta ja Nollan sesonkiin nojaavasta keittiöstä löytyy kasvisruokaa, joka ei ole jälkikäteen listalle lisätty vaihtoehto.

Tintå Turussa ja Story Vanhassa kauppahallissa tarjoavat molemmat oman kasvisannoksensa päivittäin. Jos reitti vie Jyväskylään, vegaanista lounasta tarjoaa Katriina.

## Yhteenveto

Jos haet kasvisravintolaa arki-illalle, aloita Yes Yes Yesistä. Jos etsit juhlaillallista, Grön on Helsingin kunnianhimoisin kasvispainotteinen vaihtoehto.

Molemmat vaativat pöytävarauksen viikonlopuksi. Tarkista ajantasainen lista ja hinnat ravintolan omilta sivuilta ennen käyntiä, koska sesonkilistat vaihtuvat usein.

# Magu

Magu in Helsinki serves a seasonal vegan tasting menu shaped by global kitchens and Finnish produce, recognised by the White Guide 2026.

## Magu – Helsinki's Vegan Restaurant Earning White Guide Recognition

### A plant-based restaurant with a point of view

Magu sits on Korkeavuorenkatu 27 in Helsinki, open Wednesday to Saturday evenings, and it arrives with a clear conviction: that plant-based cooking deserves the same care, creativity, and technical rigour as any other fine dining. The White Guide 2026 awarded it Fine level recognition, noting the presence of chef and forager Ossi Paloneva — a figure familiar to Finnish food culture through television appearances and food festivals dedicated to wild, local produce.

### The kitchen behind the menu

Head Chef Felipe brings a different but complementary thread to the story. His path through Helsinki kitchens — including Farang, Pastor, and Pure Bistro — gave him a foundation in global flavours before Magu sharpened his focus entirely on plant-based cooking. As he puts it, the experience taught him "to make every ingredient shine, even without meat or dairy." The result is a style built on colour, layering, and texture: dishes designed to be experienced visually before the first bite.

### What's on the plate

The current dinner menu, Flora, is priced at 79€ and reads like a considered sequence of contrasts. It opens with a watercress and pea gazpacho and flower onigiri, moves through hibiscus brioche with sorrel, soba noodles with summer truffles and sesame seeds, and a cauliflower with black garlic and rendang curry — a dish that draws on Southeast Asian spicing without losing its Finnish grounding. It closes with pine tree sorbet and a strawberry, rosemary, and almond cake. The menu changes with the seasons, paired with a selection of natural wines that evolves alongside it.

### The spirit of the place

Magu's own words resist the usual language of fine dining: "to using what grows, to trying new things, to widening the palette." That ethos — practical, curious, unshowy — runs through everything from the sourcing to the plating. For anyone serious about vegan cooking in Helsinki, this is a table worth booking.
